messages:
leo-sales: Quick one Prospect Velaris legal says they will not provision staging until we deliver a SOC2 bridge, ISO cert PDF, and a signed pen-test attestation with a named signatory on letterhead. Can we do those today?

maya-se: We have a SOC2 bridge summary (control mapping + scope page) that we share for POCs. We need redaction guidance for customer names and user IDs.

ana-security: We can provide the SOC2 bridge and the ISO cert. For the pen-test, standard practice is a signed attestation (no raw reports). I can sign as Director of Security; if procurement insists on CISO title, that will require legal loop-in.

tom-ps: Procurement also wants to confirm EU residency for the trial (eu-west-1) and a note on KMS separation. If they require customer-managed keys we need Dedicated/Private which changes pricing.

ops-bot: action: created presigned artifacts bucket (expires 7d)  DM sent to leo-sales (link hidden).

leo-sales: Great. Also: their security team asked whether auditors can run a short scan or if we can provide temporary read-only investigator access. What's our policy?

maya-se: We can offer an evidence bundle + a 90-minute walkthrough. For direct auditor access (SSO accounts) we require signed terms and ~5 business days to provision. Short scans against staging by their vendor need prior approval and an attestation that scope is limited.

ana-security: Pen-test attestation text we use: "Redwood Inference attests that a third-party penetration test was performed on YYYY-MM and no critical or high findings remained open at the time of reporting." I'll attach signed letter to the presigned bucket.

devex: Uploaded SOC2 bridge summary and ISO cert to presigned location (DM'd). Do not paste the URL in channel.

leo-sales: Next steps: 1) ana  upload signed pen-test attestation to presigned bucket TODAY; 2) maya  confirm redaction rules for SOC2 bridge TODAY; 3) tom  provide eu-west pricing delta + Dedicated KMS lead time TOMORROW; 4) schedule walkthrough if Velaris wants it (tom will own).

ana-security: Will upload attestation and include signer contact info.

tom-ps: I'll draft a short pricing delta for a 2-week POC in eu-west and timeline for key separation (est 72-96h).

leo-sales: Thanks team  I'll tell Velaris we can deliver attestation + certs today and follow up on pricing tomorrow. :thumbsup:
